title: Upgrade Difference Charges: Billing-Delay Concession Bands
content:
A Rental Property Service Contracts upgrade difference charge carries a billing-delay concession set by how long after the upgrade it is billed.

| Charge billed | Billing-delay concession |
|---|---|
| more than 30 days after the upgrade | 0.15 |
| 15 to 30 days after the upgrade | 0.05 |
| otherwise (fewer than 15 days) | 0 |

The days are the calendar days from the upgrade date (the plan change date on the contract) to the billing day.

**How the concession acts.** Concessions and credits on an upgrade difference charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

## Boundaries

| Days after the upgrade | Concession |
|---|---|
| 14 | 0 |
| 15 | 0.05 |
| 30 | 0.05 |
| 31 | 0.15 |
